_note: School of Sport container context pack for researching-research-methods-advanced. This frames research ethics, data handling and rigour for the School of Sport as a whole, drawing worked examples from across its subjects (sport & exercise science, sport coaching and physical education, sport therapy and rehabilitation, sport management and development, strength & conditioning). There is no QAA benchmark for sport in this repo, so the prose is grounded in sport & exercise science / sport domain knowledge rather than a benchmark file.
